columns.name: movieid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the movie.

columns.name: country
columns.description: The country where the movie was produced.

columns.name: isenglish
columns.description: is the movie in English.

columns.name: avg_rating
columns.description: The average rating of the movie.

columns.name: number_of_audience_occupation_5
columns.description: The number of audience with occupation 5 who watched the movie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_ratings_by_female_users
columns.description: The number of ratings given by female users for the movie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: percentage_of_female_actresses
columns.description: The percentage of female actresses in the movie

columns.name: running_time_3_ave_revenue_1
columns.description: Set to 1 if the movie has a running time of 3 and at least one director with an average revenue of 1; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: directorid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the director.

columns.name: d_quality
columns.description: The quality of the director.

columns.name: avg_revenue
columns.description: The average revenue of the director.

columns.name: num_action_movie
columns.description: The number of action movies directed by the director, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_movie_avg_rating_over_3
columns.description: The number of movies with an average rating over 3 directed by the director, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: most_common_film_genres
columns.description: The most common film genres directed by the director, with ties broken by ascending order of the genre.

columns.name: has_quality_3_and_at_least_2_genres
columns.description: Set to 1 if the director has a quality of at least 3 and has directed at least 2 genres, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: is_called_box_office_success_paradox
columns.description: Set to 1 if the director is called the "box office success paradox", otherwise, set to 0. The “box office success paradox” is defined as a director whose average revenue is greater than his or her quality.

columns.name: actorid
columns.description: Unique identifier for the actor.

columns.name: a_gender
columns.description: The gender of the actor.

columns.name: a_quality
columns.description: The quality of the actor.

columns.name: num_rating_over_3
columns.description: The number of movies the actor has acted in with an average user rating over 3, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_acted_in_at_least_2_French_films
columns.description: Set to 1 if the actor has acted in at least 2 French films, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: num_film
columns.description: The number of films the actor has acted in, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: quality_rating_3_and_acted_English_USA_movies
columns.description: Set to 1 if the actor has a quality rating of 3 and has acted in English USA movies, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: num_horror_movies
columns.description: The number of horror movies the actor has acted in, replace NULL values with 0.

    - movies2directors
postgres:

    host: elt-postgres

    - movies
